method: every writer/reader/caller hunt started from a byte scan of the PE on disk (local/pescan.py: disp, cover, disprange, imm, callto, vcall; local/vtlen.py; local/vtslots.py; local/msgkinds.py; local/mtnames.py). Two-byte 0F-prefixed opcodes decode like any other and operand widths are reported, so a 16-byte MOVUPS covering a byte field is not missed.

answers.question: what the three values of ctl+FCh gate
answers.answer: a controller mode: 0 free flight, 1 ground roll, 2 water surface. It selects the aerodynamic block in the core law (007DBE0E), dispatches 007DA380's factor arms (007DA38D), gates the ground-plane store (007DB6D1) and the wheel-height lift (007DA211), and zeroes the roll accumulator when it is 1 (007DA8D9).
answers.coverage: complete for the reader set (the disp32 FCh scan over 007D7000-007DE000 returns eleven references and no others); partial inside 007DA380's mode-1 and mode-2 arms

answers.question: who reads unit+C01h
answers.answer: nobody. Negative established by five scans: disp32 C01h (five byte writes only), every memory operand of any width covering offset C01h (the same writes plus two 16-byte clears), disp32 C00h (two byte writes, no dword read), the raw dword 00000C01h in .rdata/.data (none), and every LEA with a displacement in 0B82h-0C01h over 00600000-00A00000 (only &unit+BFCh as 006BC530's out-parameter).

answers.question: who requests unit+900h state 3
answers.answer: no code path produces 3. No immediate store uses it, the guarded setter's six call sites push 6/4/7/4-or-5/6/7 behind a guard that excludes 3, and the unguarded writer FUN_007C78A0's four callers push 6/2/1 and a replicated byte. State 3 is reachable only from a network state byte (007D160F) or a spawn/property-bag record (007D63EA, 007D65DD, 007D711A). It is consumed: 007C6347, the catapult update FUN_006EC240 at 006EC456, and FUN_007C78A0's surface-state class. 006EB5C0 is an unreferenced IsLaunching predicate.

answers.question: how to reconcile the two readings of unit+9C0h
answers.answer: two sibling class families reuse the offset. The plane family keeps a two-entry stride-8 record { byte, byte, byte, byte, float } published by FUN_007CDC70; the class-06 ship family keeps a MaxSpeed float written by BSP_UnitInstance_SEntityInit, which appears only in the five class-06 vtables. No routine mixes them.

answers.question: the bodies of unit vtable slot 144h per class
answers.answer: one body, 0077F2D0, in all 25 unit vtables; never overridden. Its only message call site is 0095AC28 in BSP_Unit_HandleMessage, the class-05 base handler.

answers.question: the bodies of unit vtable slot 208h per class
answers.answer: slot 208h is index 130, one past the end of the class-05 base vtable (204h), so each family adds its own unrelated virtual there: the ship family 008141E0 (MSubmarine 00853230), the plane family 007D0B80, MLandFort and MCommandBuilding 007460E0, MAirfield 006D0D90. MT_VEHICLE_UNIT_LAUNCH (slot, float) is the ship family's contract only.
answers.coverage: partial: 008141E0 read to its selection loop; 00853230 and 007460E0 contract: unread

answers.question: the bodies of unit vtable slots 220h, 224h and 238h per class
answers.answer: these slots exist only on the class-06 ship family; every other unit vtable ends before them, which matches their only message call sites all being in BSP_UnitInstance_HandleMessage. 220h: 008198A0, MMothership overrides with 007583A0. 224h: 008137B0, MMothership 007583F0. 238h: 008206F0, MLandingShip 0074A4C0. unit+9E4h is the steering-jam flag and unit+9E5h the engine-jam flag; unit+A14h/+A18h is the point-effect array an engine jam stops and a clear restarts.
answers.coverage: complete for 008198A0, 008137B0, 007583A0, 007583F0, 006D0D90; partial for 008206F0 (entry gate only) and 0074A4C0 (entry gate only)

answers.question: the producer of 6Ch MT_SHIP_SET_ENGINEJAMFAILURE
answers.answer: the kind is not computed. 007619B0 is a dedicated message constructor that stores it as a byte immediate (MOV byte [EAX+10h],6Ch at 007619C8), which is why a scan of the kind pushed at each of the 426 0075B430 call sites missed it. The producer is FUN_008132C0's "EngineJam" branch, which builds with 007619B0 and routes with 0077C2A0(unit, msg, 7, 0); 00827D65 is the damage-side producer and 00768FA6 the third caller.
answers.coverage: complete for 007619B0; 008132C0 read only at its three string branches

answers.question: what reads the twenty D01502F9h sentinels at director+1D0h-+21Fh
answers.answer: nothing. The value is the float -1.0e10 and the immediate occurs in exactly one instruction image-wide, the fill at 0072032E; the only other raw occurrence (00CE4ADC) is inside a string blob. Every 1D0h-21Fh access in 00700000-00730000 belongs to a gun class or to the fill, and none of the two CommandControllerBase users' own routines reads the band.
answers.coverage: partial: displacements in that band are common on unrelated classes, so matches outside 00700000-00730000 could not be attributed

answers.question: 008637D0 whole
answers.answer: __thiscall(unit, Entity* target), RET 4, AL. Walks the weapon-category list at 00E0A510 (terminated by an entry >= 0Ch) and returns 1 for the first category that is present on the unit (byte unit[cat+70h]), accepted by [unit+60h]->vtable[4h](cat), and willing to engage the target (008633D0). Otherwise 0.

answers.question: which entity director+34h is
answers.answer: the base constructor's only stack argument, the parent object the controller attaches to. The weapon director forwards its own first argument; FUN_0084D810 passes unit+310h, the tick-element node, or 0. The owning unit lives at +24Ch on the weapon director and +224h on the other subclass, so the producers that report +34h and +24Ch are reporting different fields, both correctly.

answers.question: whether anything reads the previous-command record at director+16Ch
answers.answer: yes, exactly one reader: BSP_CommandControllerBase_CopyStateFrom reads [src+16Ch] at 0072046B and copies +178h..+184h, called only from BSP_WeaponDirector_CopyStateFrom. It is a wholesale state clone, so nothing consults the record to decide behaviour. FUN_00721760's word read at +174h is on its target argument, not on a director.

answers.question: 0084E010
answers.answer: its only reference in the image is the dword at 00D0BE14, slot +7Ch of the table based at 00D0BD98 that FUN_0084D810 installs at [this]. The owner is that class: a BSP_CommandControllerBase with vtables 00D0BD98 and 00D0BD7C, the owning unit at +224h, built from 007F2070 and 007F5000. 00D0BDA4 in the same table is the fourth slot holding 0071F290 (+0Ch).
answers.coverage: none for 0084E010's body; the owner and slot are settled

answers.question: whether the shared vector at 00F87574..7C is a plain zero
answers.answer: yes. It lies past .data's rawsize (10000h backs only 00E08000-00E18000) so it is zero at load, and .text holds 1556 decoded operand references to the three addresses with not one store of any form. The address is taken at eight sites and the two PUSH sites hand it in as an input point.
answers.coverage: partial: a callee writing through one of the taken addresses was not exhaustively excluded
